internal_discovery.plain_explanation: The root ق ر ن (qrn) has 36 Quran-internal occurrences that fall into classes with no demonstrable Quran-internal bridge. (1) The largest class (20 base-noun occurrences, qarn/qurun singular and plural) denotes a bygone people/era-cohort: it is overwhelmingly the object of ahlakna 'We destroyed' and ansha'na 'We produced-after', framed by succession and pastness (min qablikum, al-ula, ansha'na min ba'dihim ... akharin) and characterized by human predicates (better in possessions 19:74, mightier in force 50:36/28:78, walking in their dwellings 20:128/32:26). Nothing in these 20 activates 'joining/coupling'. (2) A separate derivational family (8 fa'il associate-nouns qarin/qurana' plus 5 II/IV/VIII participles muqarran/muqrin/muqtarin) coheres around CONJUNCTION: coupling/binding entities into a pair or file (muqarranin fi al-asfad 14:49/38:38, the imposed devil-consort qarin 43:36/4:38, angels coming-alongside muqtarinin 43:53, capacity-to-yoke muqrinin 43:13). (3) A dual-of-qarn epithet (dhu al-qarnayn, 3 occurrences) is given no internal predication of what the two qarn are and is opaque. The etymological bridge 'a generation = people conjoined in one age' is a lexicographer's inference the Quran never surfaces; the source policy forbids treating it as authority. Per 'same root != one meaning' and the mandate to prefer the narrowest account and choose UNRESOLVED when senses have no Quran-internal bridge, the honest root-level result is multiple unbridged classes, not one nucleus. Sub-class accounts are recorded (coupling family; era-cohort class) but neither is promoted to a root claim.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: qrn does NOT entail a fixed measured time-unit ('century'): the era-cohort noun is never given a numeric span and carries only human/social predicates (19:74, 50:36, 20:128), so it is the populated cohort, not the span. It does NOT entail kinship/lineage: qurana' (assigned associates) are set alongside umam 'nations' in 41:25, and qarin is imposed (qayyada 43:36/41:25), not born. The associate-noun does NOT entail benign friendship: it is repeatedly the imposed evil consort (4:38, 43:36, fa-bi'sa al-qarin 43:38). The conjunction sense is NOT inherently coercive: forced binding (muqarranin fi al-asfad 14:49/38:38) coexists with non-coercive accompaniment (mala'ika muqtarinin 43:53). The coupling family does NOT reach temporal-succession semantics, and the era-cohort class does NOT reach relational-simultaneity semantics — they occupy different, unbridged axes. No internal 'horn' meaning is licensed: the only candidate (dual, 18:83/86/94) is never predicated.
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: 46:17:11:2 — wa-qad khalati al-qurunu min qabli ('the qurun have passed away before me'): the operative sense is purely temporal predecessor-peoples; the conjunction/coupling feature is wholly inert, so a coupling-based unifier is not the operative sense here without importing an inference the text never makes. Reinforced by 50:36 (a mightier, destroyed people of a bygone age) and by 18:83 (dhu al-qarnayn), where the dual of the very same base noun yields an opaque proper epithet with no internal gloss — disproof of unity from inside one stem.
internal_discovery.strongest_competitor: A single abstract nucleus 'to be joined into a set': qarn = people joined in one age, qarin = one joined to another, muqarran = joined/bound, muqtarin = joined-accompanying, muqrin = able to bring-alongside, qarnayn = the two-joined. It is the best pro-unity move because all 36 share the consonantal root and it cannot be disproven etymologically. It is declined as the Quran-internal account because it fits everything only by importing the joining sense into the era-cohort class (which foregrounds succession and destruction, never joining) and into the opaque dual (which the Quran never glosses); a vague abstraction that fits everything is disallowed as authority, and the joining sense is evidenced only in the qarin/participle family.

internal_discovery.rationale: Three independent lenses (A, B, adversary C) converge: there is NO single Quran-internal nucleus over all 36. Two internally coherent centers — era-cohort/generation (20/36) and conjunction/coupling (13/36) — plus an opaque dual epithet (3/36) have no Quran-internally demonstrated bridge. Per the contract's coherence rule ('If two+ senses have NO Quran-internal bridge, choose UNRESOLVED — do NOT force one nucleus'), and because the majority class resists the only nucleus the Quran actually surfaces, the root-level verdict is UNRESOLVED. A coupling account is defensible only as a REPRESENTATIVE sub-family claim (MODERATE at most), and an era-cohort account only as a distinct lexicalized-class claim; neither can be elevated to a root generalization. The dual epithet is a genuine unresolved residue.
